implemented_requirements.evidence: BudgetTracker.add validates kind "expense" and creates a Transaction (budget.py:19‑27). CLI calls add_transaction with kind "expense" (main.py:23‑33).
BudgetTracker.add validates kind "income" (budget.py:19‑27). CLI calls add_transaction with kind "income" (main.py:23‑33).
list_transactions iterates over tracker.transactions and prints each (main.py:36‑48).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Show summary of totals, balance, and savings rate
implemented_requirements.evidence: show_summary prints total income, total expense, balance, and savings_rate using BudgetTracker methods (main.py:50‑66).
delete_transaction calls tracker.remove(tid) and reports result (main.py:68‑73).

storage.save writes JSON of all transactions (storage.py:30‑34); storage.load reads it back into a BudgetTracker (storage.py:12‑22). Main program loads on start and saves on exit (main.py:78‑84, 95‑99).
BudgetTracker.total(kind) sums amounts for the given kind (budget.py:31‑33).

judge.summary: The repository provides a complete, runnable budget‑tracker CLI. Core features—adding expenses/income, listing transactions, showing totals, balance, savings rate, categorisation, deletion, and JSON persistence—are all implemented with working code. No major bugs or missing functionality were found, making the solution ready for execution.
